AiSessionDescriptor.title: AiSessionDescriptor
AiSessionDescriptor.description: The typed, tenant-scoped AI-collaboration session descriptor — the opening fact with declared peer roles; every subsequent semantic is an event, never a mutation.

AiExperienceRecordVersion.title: AiExperienceRecordVersion
AiExperienceRecordVersion.description: Exact record version admitted by this release (1).

AiSessionId.title: AiSessionId
AiSessionId.description: Collaboration session identity: "session:" followed by a lowercase slug (W010 grammar).

AiTenantId.title: AiTenantId
AiTenantId.description: Tenant scope of an AI-collaboration record: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

AiSessionScope.title: AiSessionScope
AiSessionScope.description: Optional tenant-hierarchy narrowing of a collaboration session (W009/W010 grammars).

AiPrincipalId.title: AiPrincipalId
AiPrincipalId.description: Collaboration participant principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

ParticipantRoleDescriptor.title: ParticipantRoleDescriptor
ParticipantRoleDescriptor.description: Human/agent role descriptor: the participant principal, its peer kind, the registered agent id for agent peers, and the granted interaction intents.

PeerParticipantKind.title: PeerParticipantKind
PeerParticipantKind.description: Collaboration peer participant kind — the W011 ParticipantKind subset of humans and agents (peers with typed roles).

AiAgentId.title: AiAgentId
AiAgentId.description: Registered agent identity: "agent:" followed by a lowercase slug (W003 grammar).

InteractionIntentKind.title: InteractionIntentKind
InteractionIntentKind.description: Kind of a typed interaction intent — a closed, sorted subset of the Epoch Universal interactions.
